name: Lifesteal SMP
description:
We are a semi-vanilla Minecraft server with a unique feature where you can steal hearts from other players. PvP is allowed and players can steal or raid other bases.

When you kill someone, you gain +0.5 heart, while the killed player loses -0.5 heart. There is a maximum limit of 20 hearts and a minimum limit of 10 hearts, where you no longer lose hearts.

We host events at weekends for in-game prizes! We also host giveaways for amazing items, such as ranks, Nitro, and more.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/lifestealsmp

IP: lifestealsmp.com 

(Bedrock Port 19132)
